text: This is infer: an LLM inference server I built from scratch in PyTorch.
say: This is infer. An L L M inference server I built from scratch, in PyTorch.

text: It serves Qwen2.5-0.5B with its own forward pass, and I measured it against vLLM on the same GPU.
say: It serves Kwen two point five, half a billion parameters, with its own forward pass. And I measured it against V L L M, on the same G P U.

text: Two threads split the work.
say: Two threads split the work.

text: The API side runs on an asyncio event loop: it handles HTTP, tokenization and streaming.
say: The A P I side runs on an async I O event loop. It handles H T T P, tokenization, and streaming.

text: The engine thread owns the GPU. Every step, the scheduler decides who prefills, who decodes and who is preempted.
say: The engine thread owns the G P U. Every step, the scheduler decides who prefills, who decodes, and who is preempted.

text: Then one forward pass serves them all, reading and writing a paged KV cache.
say: Then one forward pass serves them all, reading and writing a paged K V cache.

text: Here it is end to end, running on this laptop's CPU.
say: Here it is, end to end, running on this laptop's C P U.

text: The server loads the weights and sizes its KV cache.
say: The server loads the weights, and sizes its K V cache.

text: A plain curl request streams tokens back as server-sent events, in OpenAI's format.
say: A plain curl request streams tokens back as server-sent events, in Open A I's format.

text: Because the API is OpenAI-compatible, the official Python client works unchanged.
say: Because the A P I is Open A I compatible, the official Python client works unchanged.

text: The server exports Prometheus metrics: requests, KV usage and tokens.
say: The server exports Prometheus metrics: requests, K V usage, and tokens.

text: Now eight requests at once. They share every forward pass, so every stream advances on every step.
say: Now, eight requests at once. They share every forward pass, so every stream advances on every step.

text: On a T4 GPU, the same server streams fifty requests at once.
say: On a T four G P U, the same server streams fifty requests at once.

text: Forty-nine share each forward pass, the KV cache stays under one percent full, and all fifty finish in about seven seconds.
say: Forty-nine share each forward pass. The K V cache stays under one percent full, and all fifty finish in about seven seconds.

text: The benchmarks ran for about seventeen GPU hours on Kaggle, three runs per point.
say: The benchmarks ran for about seventeen G P U hours on Kaggle, three runs per point.

text: Continuous batching delivers 3.7 times the throughput of static batching, and the paged KV cache fits 17 times more sequences in the same memory.
say: Continuous batching delivers three point seven times the throughput of static batching. And the paged K V cache fits seventeen times more sequences in the same memory.

text: With the same number of users on each server, it reaches 52 to 59 percent of vLLM's throughput.
say: With the same number of users on each server, it reaches fifty-two to fifty-nine percent of V L L M's throughput.

text: The profiler shows where the rest goes: at batch 32, the GPU sits idle 85 of 96 milliseconds per step, waiting for Python to launch about 1,250 small kernels.
say: The profiler shows where the rest goes. At batch thirty-two, the G P U sits idle eighty-five of ninety-six milliseconds per step, waiting for Python to launch about twelve hundred and fifty small kernels.

text: CUDA graphs replay the whole step with one launch, cutting batch-one decode from 27 to 10 milliseconds per token.
say: CUDA graphs replay the whole step with one launch, cutting batch-one decode from twenty-seven to ten milliseconds per token.

text: But graphs only help while launches dominate; at 128 users they were slower. The final design uses them up to batch 32, and wins at every load.
say: But graphs only help while launches dominate. At a hundred and twenty-eight users, they were slower. The final design uses them up to batch thirty-two, and wins at every load.

text: Every design choice was settled by a measurement: decode-first or prefill-first, chunked prefill, prefix caching, recompute or swap.
say: Every design choice was settled by a measurement. Decode-first or prefill-first. Chunked prefill. Prefix caching. Recompute, or swap.

text: And every speed-up had to keep the golden test passing: fifty prompts, sixty-four tokens each, identical to HuggingFace in fp32.
say: And every speed-up had to keep the golden test passing. Fifty prompts, sixty-four tokens each, identical to Hugging Face, in F P thirty-two.

text: A thirty-minute soak test completed all 5,580 requests, with no memory drift.
say: A thirty-minute soak test completed all five thousand, five hundred and eighty requests, with no memory drift.

text: Half the bugs I found were in the measuring, not the server.
say: Half the bugs I found were in the measuring, not the server.

text: The code, the tests, and every raw result are in the repository.
say: The code, the tests, and every raw result, are in the repository.
